nsw_contrast.water_detail: EIS states estimated annual operational water use of 510,009 m3 (drinking water for cooling) — contestable by residents and council during exhibition.

nsw_contrast.energy_detail: Exhibited/approved SSD documents state 504MW ICT capacity (scalable toward 1GW) with a 720MVA onsite substation.
nsw_contrast.water_detail: Assessment record discloses air-based chilled-water closed-loop cooling, ~0.1L per kWh stated water efficiency.

headline: Of 13 Victorian approvals audited, 0 disclosed expected grid load (MW) in the public planning record and none published a water-demand figure — only 1 (80 Kinloch Ct) even described its cooling method — whereas all 3 NSW SSD comparators publish both MW and water figures in exhibited EIS documents. (A 14th row, 130 Cherry Lane PA2402783, was removed on verification: it is AusNet's Altona BESS, not a data centre — and notably its MW WAS disclosed.)
